League of Legends : Discussion about champ select

My main problem with League of Legends - and why I dislike it as a game so much - is how static its metagame is.

Every game must have:

  • a bruiser or tank in top lane
  • a strong bruiser with gank potential as a jungler
  • a spellcaster in mid lane
  • an AD carry and support duo in bottom lane.

Unlike other MOBAs such as DOTA 2, Heroes of the Storm and SMITE where you often see tri-lane or 2-1-2 no jungler variants, there is no variation allowed in team formation. You must have all of the above or else you will lose lanes, and potentially the entire match.

And unsurprisingly, when you require all roles to even have a shot at winning a game, and there are some roles such as Support which are seen as "bitch duty", it's no surprise that this breeds toxicity and has made League one of the most toxic communities going.
